# The bell's sources, modeled

The main file and two variants of the Christmas bell as `docs/concepts/new/circuit-dsl.md` ("The bell's variants,
modeled") sketches them – its shortened texts written out, the LED step as language 11 defines it. Text only: the
entries are the bell's, in its own repository. `tests/test_lang_golden.py` reads and formats them here and compiles
them against a clone of the bell when `BELL_ROOT` names one; the esp32 variant is not written, as the concept gives no
text of it.
